title: brachyglottis bidwillii var. viridis
intro: Brachyglottis bidwillii var. viridis, commonly known as Pittosporum or Lemonwood, is a plant species that belongs to the Pittosporaceae family. It is a shrub or small tree native to New Zealand, known for its fragrant, yellow-green leaves and small white flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Brachyglottis bidwillii var. viridis include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
